# WAS_LightGBM_Model { #wass2s.WAS_LightGBM_Model }

```python
WAS_LightGBM_Model(
    param_space=None,
    n_clusters=5,
    nb_cores=1,
    dist_method='nonparam',
    hyperparam_optimizer='bayesian',
    n_trials=50,
    n_iter=50,
    mode='cluster',
)
```

LightGBM regressor. Requires the ``lightgbm`` package.
